records.verificationNote: Read from PDL pp.39-40 (Cytokine and CAM Antagonists) by column position (preferred x~78, non-preferred x~323). Pick is the unbranded adalimumab-adaz, a preferred biosimilar; biosimilars are not generics, so genericAvailable is false. Conflict: HUMIRA appears in the preferred column (p.39) and as 'CDV HUMIRA (adalimumab)' in the non-preferred column (p.39); Humira is not used as the pick and is listed as an alternative only. IV infliximab is not on the PDL; ZYMFENTRA (SC infliximab) is listed. Strength and dosing are standard label values, not printed in the PDL. [Sonnet check 2026-10-27: the Humira conflict is not a text-layer error. HUMIRA is preferred and "CDV HUMIRA" (the co-branded Humira NDC) is a separate listing in the non-preferred column, so both are real. Added CDV Humira to paRequired. records.verificationNote: Humira 40 mg read as P with PA, QL 2 syringes or pens/28 days, SP (PDF p.67; x-coordinate check: PA at x~429-437). Adalimumab-adbm and -aaty are printed unbranded biosimilars with the same tier and PA. records.verificationNote: Otulfi 45 mg/0.5 mL syringe read on page 72: Tier 3 (Preferred Brand), PA and QL 1.5 per 84 days. No IL-17 or IL-23 agent in this class is listed without PA. Otulfi is a ustekinumab biosimilar, the lowest tier in the class. The pick is a judgment call: the 45 mg strength is the lowest-tier listed product. Brodalumab (Siliq), bimekizumab (Bimzelx), ixekizumab (Taltz), tildrakizumab (Ilumya) and the other ustekinumab biosimilars (Wezlana, Selarsdi, Pyzchiva, Imuldosa, Steqeyma) are not listed. Omlyclo (omalizumab) appears on page 72 but is outside this class. [Sonnet check 2026-10-27: Re-read by x-coordinate on v17 pages 70-74. Adjudicated: Otulfi and Yesintek are both Tier 3 (Preferred Brand) with PA and QL 1.5 per 84 days for the 45 mg dose, so Otulfi is one of two equal picks, not the sole preferred product; Stelara and unbranded ustekinumab are Tier 5. Ustekinumab blocks IL-12/23 (the class definition includes it); Cosentyx, Tremfya and Skyrizi, the IL-17 and IL-23 agents, are all Tier 5 with PA, so the ustekinumab biosimilar is the lowest-barrier product.]
